input.label: SUPPORTED

supporting_evidence.quote: Debt, net of debt issuance costs and discounts, decreased $1,120 million primarily due to approximately $1,833 million in repayments of debt

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Netflix's long-term debt was lower as of December 31, 2025 than at December 31, 2024. Evidence E3 provides the consolidated balance sheet showing long-term debt of $13,463,971 thousand as of December 31, 2025 compared to $13,798,351 thousand as of December 31, 2024. This represents a decrease of $334,380 thousand. Evidence E4 corroborates this, stating that "Debt, net of debt issuance costs and discounts, decreased $1,120 million primarily due to approximately $1,833 million in repayments of debt, partially offset by the remeasurement of our Euro-denominated notes in the year ended December 31, 2025." Since $13,463,971 < $13,798,351, the claim is supported by the evidence.
